climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A Languedoc-Roussillon appellation around Limoux, covering sparkling and still wines. Mauzac, Chardonnay and Chenin are used for whites, and Merlot mostly for reds. Limoux claims the world's first sparkling wine, made by monks at Saint-Hilaire and recorded in 1531.
